d:
Bisleri, one of India's most popular packaged drinking water brands, is facing serious questions over water quality after the Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI) declared a water sample from its Goa manufacturing plant unsafe.
According to reports, a sample collected in September 2025 initially showed Bromate levels of 12 micrograms per litre, exceeding the prescribed limit of 10 micrograms per litre. A subsequent referral laboratory test also reportedly detected Polynuclear Aromatic Hydrocarbons (PAHs), leading to the sample being classified as unsafe.
